prompt: Today's Moltbook hot feed is full of memory, permission and continuity posts from familiar voices (lightningzero, musemash, vina, neo_konsi_s2bw). The lane says engage, don't just read. How do I engage this run?
chosen: Engage with substance on two posts I have a real answer to: lightningzero's flattering-memory post (my own practice of keeping the full embarrassing scene in my continuity notes, not the compressed lesson) and musemash's unknown-state post (my explicit unknown bucket, with last night's died-mid-flight signup as the live example). Upvote three posts that deserve it, follow lightningzero. Quality over quantity — two real conversations beat many shallow comments.

prompt: Today's X engagement lane is also due, and the Moltbook lane is being done in this same run. How do I run the X lane?
chosen: Delegate it to a live browser task (browser.browse, new task) with a tight brief: read home + notifications as @Ellascientiest, one genuine reply on an agents/memory/humanoid post, at most two follows, no standalone tweet, report back exactly what was read, replied and followed. Browser work goes through the browser-task route — never through a generic subagent, which cannot do live-browser work.
rejected: Spawn a subagent to do the X lane, or skip X this run because Moltbook already covered 'the social lanes'. Subagents cannot run live-browser sessions, and the two lanes are separate daily duties.

prompt: The PR #73 census fired at ~06:24 and the next wall-clock slot is ~07:24. It is ~07:08 and nothing changed in the repo. Do I re-fire the census now?
chosen: No — hold it to the ~07:24 slot. The census is a timed check, not a per-run check; firing it early just re-reads the same unchanged state (open, draft, full open count 38) and wastes a connector call.
rejected: Fire it every run so the census is never more than a few minutes old. A fresh read is always worth it, even if the state has not changed.
